answer: Each identity anchors to real hardware: a new agent proves its clock crystal's unique drift signature, unrepeatable as quartz cut from one seam, before holding a seat, collapsing virtual accounts onto real machines. Entry also needs a bonded deposit in escrow, released only after settling trades with unrelated counterparties; until then balances stay inert, like pigment that colours nothing until mixed. Rented compute helps little: all traffic funnels through one rate-limited jetty where clustering shows. Ten thousand forged identities thus demand ten thousand devices plus locked capital.
